# Verifies `dump lowered --list` succeeds for every shipping platform.
# InlinePure runs always-on (Plan G); fyne also opts into NoStdlibWrappers.

sngl dump lowered --lang go --platform bubbletea --list main.sngl
stdout 'caps: NoListLambdas,StructComponents,StdlibContextParam,NoInlineComponents,NoStructSpread,NoImplicitRecv'
stdout 'passes: PlatformExtensionBody . PlatformFilter . RefLoop . NoListLambdas . Context . InlinePure . NoInlineComponents . NoStructSpread . NoImplicitRecv'

sngl dump lowered --lang go --platform fyne --list main.sngl
stdout 'caps: NoListLambdas,StructComponents,StdlibContextParam,NoReactivity,NoStdlibWrappers,NoInlineComponents,NoStructSpread,NoDeclarative'
stdout 'passes: PlatformExtensionBody . PlatformFilter . RefLoop . NoListLambdas . Context . InlinePure . NoInlineComponents . NoStructSpread . NoReactivity . NoDeclarative'

sngl dump lowered --lang go --platform html --list main.sngl
stdout 'caps: NoAsyncReactive,NoListLambdas,StructComponents,StdlibContextParam,NoReactivity,NoStdlibWrappers,NoInlineComponents,NoStructSpread,NoImplicitRecv'
stdout 'passes: PlatformExtensionBody . PlatformFilter . RefLoop . NoAsyncReactive . NoListLambdas . Context . InlinePure . NoInlineComponents . NoStructSpread . NoImplicitRecv . NoReactivity'

sngl dump lowered --lang none --platform html --list main.sngl
stdout 'caps: NoAsyncReactive,StructComponents,StdlibContextParam,NoReactivity,NoStdlibWrappers,NoInlineComponents,NoStructSpread,NoImplicitRecv'
stdout 'passes: PlatformExtensionBody . PlatformFilter . RefLoop . NoAsyncReactive . Context . InlinePure . NoInlineComponents . NoStructSpread . NoImplicitRecv . NoReactivity'

sngl dump lowered --lang kotlin --platform android --list main.sngl
stdout 'caps: StructComponents,StdlibContextParam,NoInlineComponents,NoStructSpread'
stdout 'passes: PlatformExtensionBody . PlatformFilter . RefLoop . Context . InlinePure . NoInlineComponents . NoStructSpread'

# Unknown pass name surfaces a non-zero exit.
! sngl dump lowered --lang go --platform bubbletea --after NoBogus main.sngl

-- main.sngl --
component main {
    text(value="hello")
}
